INSERT INTO device_logs (
            device_mac,
            crash_number,
            uptime_ms,
            software_version,
            reset_reason,
            program_counter,
            exception_cause,
            task_name
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
        ON CONFLICT (device_mac, crash_number) DO NOTHING
